description: Machine-readable form of the package table in reports/3.15.1/READINESS_RECONCILIATION_2026-10-26_v2.md. Consumed by scripts/ingest_evidence.py.

standard.pass_requires: A workload actually executed on Python 3.15.1 (evidence_level Functional or Integration).
rules: A resolver success is never a PASS.
A failed install caused by an upstream pin or missing wheel is BLOCKED, not INCOMPAT.
Test-design errors are not counted against a package.
Baselines and prior reports are never rewritten.
